verdict.rationale: Disputes and chargebacks are a fair question for a payments processor, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents chargeback responses, evidence submission, or dispute lifecycle tracking. The pack covers card payments, refunds/voids, 3DS, network tokens, recurring charges and POS, but refunds are an adjacent feature, not chargeback handling.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can respond to a chargeback with structured evidence and track the dispute lifecycle to resolution
